decisions.reason: Actually inspected original/return alpha comparison. Required source-specific correction: The original is a strict LEFT-FACING PROFILE showing ONLY ONE EYE. The latest target still shows a second prominent green eye at the far edge and still stretches a long yellow throat above the orange shirt. Redraw this exact source as a true side silhouette with ONE visible eye, the far eye completely hidden by the head, matching original direction, hairstyle and gaze. Use a compact near-round head with curved chin and VERY SHORT BROAD neck transition fitted directly at the shoulders and orange shirt. Preserve the grey uniform, black tie, actual leaf collar insignia and crop; do not rotate the face toward the viewer, lengthen the neck, invent a cream bib or new symbols. Preserve full restored original painted background, actual uniform and full raw resolution. No programmatic art patch.
